exposure: ceasing dexamphetamine before the end of the second trimester
unexposed (dispensed ADHD medication prior to pregnancy but not during)
outcome: adverse neonatal and maternal health outcomes
cohort: A population-based retrospective cohort of women from Western Australia who had been dispensed dexamphetamine during pregnancy and gave birth between 2003 and 2018, including a matched comparison group of women who were dispensed an ADHD medication prior to pregnancy but not during pregnancy.
finding: Continuing dexamphetamine throughout pregnancy was not associated with an increase in adverse neonatal and maternal health outcomes compared to ceasing, though ceasing was associated with increased odds of threatened abortion, while the unexposed group showed some benefits compared to continuers.
